title: Form 141 for TDS: Understanding the New Challan-cum-Statement
description: Form 141 is a new unified challan-cum-statement introduced under the Income Tax Act 2025 to simplify TDS compliance. It combines the payment of Tax Deducted a.

faq.q: What is the primary purpose of Form 141?
faq.a: Form 141's primary purpose is to simplify TDS compliance for specific taxpayers by combining the challan (for tax payment) and the statement (for reporting deductions) into a single, unified form under the Income Tax Act 2025.

faq.q: Is Form 141 applicable to all TDS transactions?
faq.a: No, Form 141 is specifically designed for certain TDS transactions, primarily those involving individuals and HUFs not subject to tax audit, such as rent payments under Section 194-IB and professional/contractual payments under Section 194M.
Form 141 is designed for online submission through the official Income Tax e-filing portal. This ensures efficiency and reduces manual processing.

faq.q: What happens if I miss the Form 141 deadline?
faq.a: Missing the deadline for Form 141 submission can attract interest under Section 234E for late filing of the statement and potentially interest for late payment of TDS under other relevant sections of the Income Tax Act.

faq.q: How is Form 141 different from Forms 26QB, 26QC, 26QD?
faq.a: Forms 26QB, 26QC, and 26QD are existing challan-cum-statements for specific transactions like TDS on property, rent, and payments to residents for certain services. Form 141 is a *new* unified form under the Income Tax Act 2025, likely replacing or consolidating some of these existing specific forms for individuals and HUFs, aiming for broader applicability across specified transactions.

faq.q: Do NRIs also need to file Form 141 for certain transactions?
faq.a: The primary focus of Form 141, as per initial understanding, is on individuals and HUFs who are residents. However, specific TDS provisions for NRIs are governed by other sections. Taxpayers, including NRIs, should always refer to the latest CBDT notifications for clarity on applicability.

faq.q: Where can I find the official Form 141?
faq.a: Once officially notified and made operational, Form 141 will be available on the Income Tax Department's e-filing portal (incometax.gov.in) under the relevant sections for TDS compliance.
